services.value: ESC provides environmental assessment and consulting, including Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments. It also offers air emissions air testing (with mobile laboratories), plus wastewater sampling/field analysis/reporting, stormwater instruction/test kits/sampling/field analysis/reporting, tanks and planning compliance review/sampling/groundwater profiling/closure support, hazardous waste sampling/reporting/permit assistance, environmental site assessments, landfill and groundwater sampling/reporting, and surface water lake/river studies.
